translation: The accumulation has a shape like a snake, with size, length, and shortness not uniform; at ordinary times it is one lump and one strip, lying attached between the sinews and bones. It must wait for the original place to be drawn and moved, then it rises up in the neck, threads straight through both jaws, coils around the neck, and goes down through the inside of the Adam's apple, carrying away all that was lying attached. Although it is extremely thick and large, the throat naturally opens and yields. What came out of my neck was no less than several tens or hundreds of strips, of varying duration. There were even times in the middle of the night, in sleep and dreams, when the shoulders and jaws were filled up and evil arose in the forehead; I woke with a start, sat up, and rubbed it away.
